scope: Proposition 5.3 (Independent curve correspondences) of the manuscript “The generalized Mukai conjecture” (preprints/The-Generalized-Mukai-Conjecture-September-24-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 063 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0273a9c7907eb9d1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that the quantum divisor operators A1(q), . . . , Ar(q) have an algebraically independent joint eigenvalue tuple over C. There are linearly independent numerical degree vectors γ1, . . . , γr of positive genus-zero stable maps such that Sγ1 · · · Sγr ̸= 0, r X j=1 (dγj − 1) ≤ n. (15) Consequently r(ι − 1) ≤ n.
